method: Independent manual nonauthor source audits of all current canonical and depth written prompts, hints and keys, including all append/mutation sites. Final authored repairs receive a distinct review. No learner observation or authored-program execution is implied.
limits: Worked examples, laboratories, concept checks, figures, appendices and generated editions retain their existing separately declared review/check scope.
Source task/key review and exact identity accounting establish no human qualification, learner mastery, verified delay or unseen performance.
